critique: Three passes of three: Collect is the largest, lightest saturated control and leads; the XP panel, currency strip and island pills sit behind it.

Three fails of three: the headline currency counts (1,460 / 142.0k / 31.4k / 61.0k) are flat cream Manrope on dark plates, with no outline, hard drop or gradient. Fix: give the counts the display treatment (ink outline and hard drop, or a gradient fill).

Three fails of three: the only character is the small Keeper avatar badge (about 65 to 75 px), pale and soft against its ring, against the anchor's framed portrait band. Fix: put a larger, outlined character on home.

Three fails of three: the currency counts stay flat cream with no outline or drop, and the 'Guardião 24' header sits over the starfield with only a soft shadow, no ink outline. Fix: as at 100%, and outline the header.
Three passes of three: 'Coletar 3,4 mil' is the lightest, largest filled control and leads; the Home tab is under half its size.
Three passes of three: gold fill only on Collect, red only on attention badges, resource bars in their resources' colours with icons, school pips distinct on all three colour-blindness views.
Three passes of three: Collect is the largest solid light control and the only saturated gold block; the gold tabs are half its size or less.
